highlights: Delivered [b]generative AI solutions[/b] from customer discovery and rapid prototypes through production rollout and feedback-led iteration.
Built stateful agents with [b]LangChain and Google ADK[/b], covering tool routing, durable memory, model fallbacks, human approvals, and long-running workflows.
Built [b]RAG and embedding pipelines[/b] with semantic chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, filtering, and reranking in [b]pgvector[/b].
Built secure [b]MCP clients and servers[/b] for tools, resources, and prompts over Streamable HTTP using OAuth 2.1, protected-resource discovery, DCR, and PKCE.
Implemented [b]A2A[/b] Agent Cards and task workflows for agent discovery, delegation, multi-turn context, streamed status and artifacts, and cancellation.
Built [b]AG-UI[/b] event streams for messages, tool calls, synchronized state, approvals, interrupts, and resumable sessions in user-facing applications.
Used [b]Pydantic Evals[/b] for regression testing and [b]Langfuse[/b] for production tracing across quality, latency, tokens, cost, and failures.
Developed an [b]Enterprise Service Bus (ESB)[/b] supporting data transformation and parallel batch execution.
Led migration from [b]Angular 16 -> 19[/b] and [b]Jakarta 8 -> 10[/b] across shared libraries and app modules, including creation of migration scripts and guildes for upstream consumers.
Ensured 90% plus unit test code coverage using [b]Karma, Junit & Mockito[/b] as well as end to end testing using [b]Cypress[/b].
Built an insurance claims dashboard using [b]React[/b] with fraud-detection using machine learning and a [b]GraphQL[/b] aggregation layer to support the dashboard.
Integrated [b]Kafka[/b] and [b]WebSockets[/b] for real-time notifications from on-call events.
Built an [b]Angular[/b] dashboard consuming [b]REST APIs[/b] built using [b]Springboot[/b] for policyholder information.
